description: This source file implements HTTP download management, including URL setting, download progress monitoring, device reboot, LED control, and factory reset for a device firmware update process. It contains functions for handling HTTP download status, device reboot readiness, and system state checks, with integration to hardware abstraction layers and system events.

methods.name: Set_HTTP_Download_Url
methods.description: Sets the HTTP download URL and filename, retrieves and confirms the URL setting.

methods.name: filePresentCheck
methods.description: Checks if a specified file exists.

methods.name: isStateRedSupported
methods.description: Checks if the device supports state red recovery by verifying the presence of a specific script.

methods.name: isInStateRed
methods.description: Determines if the device is currently in a red recovery state.

methods.name: checkAndEnterStateRed
methods.description: Checks conditions and sets the device into red recovery state if needed.

methods.name: HTTP_Download
methods.description: Manages the HTTP download process, monitors progress, handles retries, and updates system state and LEDs.

methods.name: Reboot_Ready
methods.description: Checks if the device is ready to reboot after download.

methods.name: HTTP_Download_Reboot_Now
methods.description: Triggers device reboot after download completion.

methods.name: HTTP_LED_Flash
methods.description: Controls the device LED flashing state.
